item.title: Seven million lice-eating fish have died at Scottish salmon farms
item.description: A campaigner has made the first estimate of the total number of cleaner fish that have died while grazing lice on farmed salmon. It’s condemned as a “colossal waste of life” that should cease.

item.title: Claim that video shows bagpiper playing over call to prayer in Scotland is False
item.description: A video showing a man playing bagpipes during a Muslim call to prayer was widely shared on social media this week, after being boosted by accounts critical of Islam. The short clip was posted on X numerous times, with accounts stating it showed a call to prayer in Scotland.

item.title: This Highland estate took £1.5m in taxpayer cash but let deer run riot across protected areas
item.description: Scottish authorities had to intervene to keep deer numbers down at a Sutherland estate after the overpopulated animals damaged protected areas. Meanwhile, the landowner has received vast sums of public money.

item.title: Farmed salmon were treated with a lot more drugs than the industry said
item.description: The credibility of the salmon farming industry has come under attack after it admitted underestimating by 66 per cent the amount of antibiotics used to treat diseased fish in 2024.

item.title: Scotland’s prisoner transport provider is linked to Trump’s ICE migrant hunters
item.description: Scotland’s prison transport operator has been condemned for performance failures. It’s co-owned by a US corporation supplying bounty hunters for Donald Trump’s mass deportation initiative.

item.title: The UAE is accused of arming a genocidal militia in Sudan. The Scottish Government wants closer ties
item.description: The Scottish Government's "courting" of the Gulf state comes as human rights groups raise allegations about its role in Sudan’s devastating war.

item.title: Concern over bid to exempt organic food certification from public scrutiny
item.description: Campaigners asked for inspection reports on organic salmon farms in Scotland. It led to an appeal which could limit the public right to access environmental information.

item.title: Why can’t I get an appointment with my GP?
item.description: The pressing need to address difficulties the Scottish public reports in getting an appointment with their GP was raised in last week’s budget. So will new funding and proposals for walk-in surgeries help? What are the underlying reasons for the issue?

item.title: Political parties took thousands from lobbying groups in Scotland. Campaigners say they are buying access to power
item.description: Political parties have accepted thousands of pounds from lobbyists in recent years. Anti-corruption campaigners claimed donations buy lobby firms “privileged access” to politicians for their wealthy clients.

item.title: Poland's Jewish revival: In the shadow of Auschwitz
item.description: We visited the Polish city of Krakow ahead of Holocaust Memorial Day which is held to remember the millions murdered by the Nazis – including six million Jews. Krakow's Jewish population was decimated then but the city is now home to one of the fastest-growing Jewish communities in the world.
